response.answer: Current trends in trajectory optimization include sequential convex optimization and GPU acceleration for faster computation. Innovative ideas involve differentiable surrogates for real-time adjustments and homotopy preservation techniques for maintaining solution paths. These methods enhance obstacle handling and overall optimization efficiency.
